title: How to download
patterns: where do i get the files
how do i get started after buying
response: After payment: open the e-mail, click the download link, save the archive to a folder with enough free space, then extract it (7-Zip or WinRAR, both free) and copy the extracted folder to your USB drive. The members area has a video walking through it.

title: How long the download takes
keywords: how long does the download take
patterns: how big is the download file
how long does it take to download
how long does the download take
how long will the download take
response: It depends on your connection, and cloud drives let you pause and resume. On a typical 100 Mbps business line it takes well under an hour; on a slower link, start it and come back later. Downloads are unlimited and you can re-download whenever you want.

title: Copying to the USB drive
patterns: how do i put it on a usb
how do i copy the files
do i need to format the usb
how do i prepare the usb drive
response: Use a {{USB_SIZE}} USB 3.0 drive formatted as exFAT or NTFS, then copy the whole extracted folder to it — keeping the folder structure intact matters. The video tutorial in the members area shows this step by step.
